name: live-v5-foreign-blob
objective: v2.3 replan V5, live (no model): (1) a chat whose saved state is stamped for ANOTHER chat reads as no story, and the stored state is left byte-for-byte as it was (the pre-V5 read wrote an empty blob over it, so the next save erased it), with the mismatch in the session journal; (2) a real ST rename (`ctx.renameChat`, which keeps the file's metadata under a new chat id) keeps the story instead of reading as someone else's. The step renames the chat back to its original id, which checks the stamp follows a second rename and lets the sandbox guard and cleanup see their own chat. T7 wave C (2026-10-03): the chat plays an inline story with NO checkpoint effects instead of sun-ruins. Since story-scoped lore (T5-2-2, f7342021) sun-ruins' Xentar Checkpoints requirement reads met, so its start checkpoint applies its Author's Note and cast changes and the effect ledger holds rows. Re-reading the chat as storyless clears the story, and clearStory first runs the exit restore (runtimeManager.ts:211, effects.restoreFor(extras, 'exit')), which settles those rows on the in-memory extras; this fixture swaps the stamp IN PLACE on the same chat, so those extras are the very blob under test (persist keeps them by reference) and the byte check failed on the restore, not on the foreign read. A real foreign blob arrives with a chat change, when the restore settles the previous chat's extras. A guard step requires an empty effect ledger before the stamp swap, so the byte check is about the read alone.

import_story.title: SO-V5 Blob
import_story.description: v2.3 replan V5: a story with no checkpoint effects, so loading, leaving and re-reading it writes nothing outside the story blob.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const storyId = rt.getSnapshot().storyId; const blob = ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator; if (!storyId || !blob?.stories?.[storyId]) throw new Error('setup: no story state to protect'); if ((rt.getSnapshot().effects?.ledger ?? []).length) throw new Error(`setup: the effect ledger must be empty before the stamp swap, or the exit restore settles rows on this very blob: ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().effects.ledger.map((row) => row.effect))}`); const own = blob.chatId; blob.chatId = 'so-v5-elsewhere'; const before = JSON.stringify(blob); await rt.loadSelectedFromChat(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const after = JSON.stringify(ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator); const journal = JSON.stringify(rt.getSessionJournal()); const snapshotStory = rt.getSnapshot().storyId; blob.chatId = own; await rt.loadSelectedFromChat(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const back = rt.getSnapshot().storyId; const result = { storyId, foreignStory: snapshotStory, untouched: before === after, journaled: journal.includes('blob-chat-mismatch: stamped for so-v5-elsewhere'), back }; if (snapshotStory !== null) throw new Error(`a foreign-stamped blob was read: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (!result.untouched) throw new Error(`the foreign blob was changed by reading it: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (!result.journaled) throw new Error(`the mismatch was not journaled: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (back !== storyId) throw new Error(`the chat did not recover its own story: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); return result;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const storyId = rt.getSnapshot().storyId; const from = String(ctx.chatId); const to = `so-v5-renamed-${Date.now()}`; await ctx.renameChat(from, to); const deadline = Date.now() + 15000; while (Date.now() < deadline && (String(SillyTavern.getContext().chatId) !== to || rt.getSnapshot().storyId !== storyId)) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); const now = SillyTavern.getContext(); const result = { from, to, openChat: String(now.chatId), stamped: now.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator?.chatId ?? null, storyBefore: storyId, storyAfter: rt.getSnapshot().storyId }; if (result.openChat !== to) throw new Error(`the rename did not land: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (result.stamped !== to) throw new Error(`the blob still carries the old chat id: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (result.storyAfter !== storyId) throw new Error(`the renamed chat lost its story: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); await now.renameChat(to, from); const back = Date.now() + 15000; while (Date.now() < back && (String(SillyTavern.getContext().chatId) !== from || SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.story_orchestrator?.chatId !== from || rt.getSnapshot().storyId !== storyId)) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); const home = SillyTavern.getContext(); result.renamedBack = { openChat: String(home.chatId), stamped: home.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator?.chatId ?? null, story: rt.getSnapshot().storyId }; if (result.renamedBack.openChat !== from || result.renamedBack.stamped !== from || result.renamedBack.story !== storyId) throw new Error(`renaming back did not carry the story home: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); return result;
